committee.sub: Morning brief · Tuesday 10 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend eased to A$135.69 over the last 7 days (18 clicks, CPC A$7.54) but conversionsLast7 sits at zero, and the A$600 test credit is now fully drawn (creditRemainingExGst $0).

Impression share is only 10% over 30 days, with 78.6% lost to rank against 13.4% lost to budget, so rank is the bigger constraint right now; no external account changes in the last 24h or 7 days, so test numbers aren't contaminated from that angle.
Of 98 raw paid clicks since the test began, 17 clicked the ask-first CTA and 4 clicked quick question, but review_cta_click is still zero, so the deeper booking step has drawn no raw clicks at all.

Organic Search ticked up to 9 sessions from 8 last period, still the only trustworthy unpaid signal; AI Assistant stayed at zero so there's no answer-engine visibility to report yet, and Search Console data only runs through Sat 7, two days behind yesterday (Mon 9).

actions.text: totalPaidClicks has reached 98, well past the 75-click flag; have Chris check the test log now and if relevant clicks are 75+ with zero qualified enquiries, call the red flag.

creditRemainingExGst is now $0, so the decision point is live: pause paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review (review_cta_click is still 0).
The page passed 25 raw clicks long ago and now sits at 98: leave the headline, offer and CTAs frozen unless something is genuinely broken.
generate_lead fired twice since the test started; check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source details on each and grade them against the qualified rule in the test log.
Standing item: logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update them to current site stats.
